# wisp-science v1.16.0

**Use several ChatGPT accounts in one place, see how much quota each one has left, and switch between them.**

`v1.16.0` rebuilds subscription sign-in around accounts. **Settings → Models → Subscription accounts** is now its own tab next to API models and ACP Agents. It can hold several ChatGPT accounts, shows each account's 5-hour and weekly usage, and imports sign-ins you already have from Codex CLI or CLIProxyAPI. Sign-in and token refresh can use a proxy separate from model requests. The ChatGPT HTTP 400 error and tool-only turns that came back empty are fixed. This release also fixes several places where the window froze on Windows. The work shipped in [#1366](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1366), [#1373](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1373), [#1378](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1378) and [#1396](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1396).

## Downloads

- **macOS (.dmg, signed + notarized)**: Apple Silicon (aarch64) and Intel (x86_64); compatible versions can update in-app.
- **macOS SwiftUI Preview (.dmg, signed + notarized)**: `Wisp-Science-SwiftUI-Preview_1.16.0_aarch64.dmg` and `_x86_64.dmg`, each with a `.sha256` file. The v1.15.0 preview build failed, so this is its first published build. See the Compatibility section before installing.
- **Windows (MSI / NSIS)**: installers remain unsigned while SignPath release signing is disabled.
- **Linux (deb / AppImage)**: x86_64 and aarch64.

Installers will appear in Assets as the platform builds finish. The [website download page](https://wispscience.com/#download) also provides platform-specific installer links backed by the configured download mirror.

## Subscriptions

### Accounts and models are set up separately

- **Settings → Models** now has three tabs: **API models**, **ACP Agents** and **Subscription accounts**. Subscriptions no longer appear in the API model list or its protocol options.
- ChatGPT and SuperGrok each manage their own sign-in. Saving an account creates no model. Add as many models to the account as you need, each with only a **model ID** and an **alias**. Signing in again updates the credentials of every model from that source.
- Editing a subscription model can no longer turn it into a plain API model by mistake.
- **Save account** sits next to Cancel and shows progress while it saves. If saving fails, the authorization is kept, so you can retry without signing in again.

### Several ChatGPT accounts

- The ChatGPT card has **Add account** and **Import local sign-in**, plus a list of accounts. Each row shows the email, the plan and an **Active account** badge for the one in use.
- Each account shows a 5-hour and a weekly usage bar with a reset countdown. A bar turns amber at 80% and red at 100%. **Refresh usage** reloads the numbers.
- One account is active at a time. **Use this account** switches every ChatGPT model to that account, and the next turn uses it. Inactive accounts can be removed after a confirmation. The active account cannot be removed.
- **Import local sign-in** reads Codex CLI's `$CODEX_HOME/auth.json` (default `~/.codex/auth.json`) and CLIProxyAPI's `~/.cli-proxy-api/codex-*.json`. It keeps the newest copy of each account. A copy older than the one Wisp already has is skipped.
- An account you saved before this release shows up as the active account the first time the list loads.

### Sign-in network and error messages

- **Settings → Network → Subscription sign-in** sets a proxy only for ChatGPT/xAI sign-in, token refresh and quota queries. It offers System, Direct or Custom and defaults to System. You can send model requests directly and still route sign-in through a proxy. Network settings are now their own item, directly below General.
- Sign-in errors now include the underlying network cause, and OpenAI's unsupported-region response is reported as such. Neither message includes tokens or response bodies.
- ChatGPT: sending a message after sign-in no longer fails with HTTP 400. Wisp no longer sends the `max_output_tokens` field, which the subscription endpoint rejects. When a request uses a parameter the endpoint does not support, the error now names that parameter.
- ChatGPT: turns that contain only tool calls are no longer reported as empty responses.
- ChatGPT: sign-in accepts tokens whose expiry comes only from the JWT, handles cancellation and late callbacks correctly, and shows a readable message for an HTML 403 page instead of the raw HTML.
- Windows: long ChatGPT/xAI credentials no longer fail to save because of Credential Manager's 2560-byte limit. They are stored as protected, checksummed pieces in the keyring. Credentials never fall back to SQLite or plain files.

## Fewer Windows Freezes

- v1.15 migrated old project databases on the UI thread at startup, so a large app database could leave the window unresponsive before it drew. Startup no longer migrates old projects. They keep working from the app database. A project is migrated only when you turn on cloud-drive sync for it.
- Filesystem commands in the Files panel no longer run on the UI thread, so large folders, cloud-drive placeholders and network shares no longer freeze the window ([#1380](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1380)).
- Showing the desktop pet no longer deadlocks when its window has to be created ([#1381](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1381)). The Windows Snap overlay on the maximize button now installs ([#1379](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1379)).
- Fixed a UI failure where message rows or artifact cards removed during streaming slowly used up the WebAssembly stack. In long sessions this could leave a window that neither rendered nor accepted input.
- An offline MCP connector is not retried on every turn. The failure is remembered for 60 seconds, which removes a delay of about two seconds before each message on Windows.
- Upgraded to Tauri 2.12.

## Other Improvements and Fixes

- **Decentralized project storage** under **Settings → General** chooses where new projects keep their data: in their own folder, or in the shared app database. It is off for new installs and for upgrades straight from v1.14. Installs that already ran v1.15.0 keep it on. Changing it does not move existing projects.
- A chat model that was mistakenly assigned to image generation can be recovered with **Restore as chat model**. Its ID and credentials stay the same.
- Automatic review, follow-up questions and memory proposals now also run for turns started from the queue, IM channels, schedules and delegation, not only when a window is open. Cancelled, refused or cut-off ACP turns are no longer reviewed.
- Completed Run monitors are folded into one Processed group, and the turn duration is shown once instead of on every group.
- An open artifact preview no longer resets its zoom, tabs or unsaved code edits when new output arrives. During a running turn, earlier messages keep **Copy**, **Memory** and **Branch**.
- Local images in restored conversation history load again.
- Directory paths in chat open in Files. Missing paths are shown as plain text instead of broken links.
- On short windows, the lower sidebar entries fold into **More**. All text now scales in proportion with the UI font size. The inbox badge counts only the current project.
- The native SwiftUI (macOS) and WinUI 3 (Windows) previews now match more of the WebView app, including settings, message rendering with code highlighting and math, the artifact panel, the research journey, the calendar and the publication workspace.

## Compatibility and Scope

- **Decentralized project storage** is off for fresh installs and for upgrades from v1.14. Existing projects stay in the app database until you turn on cloud-drive sync for them. Don't downgrade below v1.15 after a project has moved to its own folder.
- An imported ChatGPT sign-in shares its refresh token with Codex CLI or CLIProxyAPI. After Wisp refreshes it, that tool may ask you to sign in again. Wisp does not rotate accounts automatically when one reaches its limit.
- The SwiftUI and WinUI settings still show a single ChatGPT account. WinUI has no subscription sign-in page yet.
- Quota bars read ChatGPT's usage endpoint, which is not publicly documented and may change.
- Building from source now needs Rust 1.90 or later.
- **SwiftUI Preview** requires macOS 13 or later and installs next to the regular app as **Wisp Science Preview.app**. It uses the same project data, settings and keyring as the WebView app, so it does not isolate your data. It updates only by manual download and is not yet feature-complete. The WebView app and its in-app updater are unchanged.

# wisp-science v1.16.0

**在一个地方管理多个 ChatGPT 账号，查看每个账号的剩余额度，并随时切换。**

`v1.16.0` 以账号为中心重做了订阅登录。**设置 → 模型 → 订阅账号**现在是独立标签页，与 API 模型、ACP Agents 并列。可以保存多个 ChatGPT 账号，查看每个账号 5 小时和每周的额度用量，也可以导入 Codex CLI 或 CLIProxyAPI 中已有的登录。登录和令牌刷新可以使用与模型请求不同的代理。本版本修复了 ChatGPT 的 HTTP 400 错误，以及只有工具调用的轮次返回空结果的问题，还修复了 Windows 上几处导致窗口卡住的问题。实现见 [#1366](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1366)、[#1373](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1373)、[#1378](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1378) 和 [#1396](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/pull/1396)。

## 下载

- **macOS（.dmg，已签名 + 公证）**：Apple Silicon（aarch64）与 Intel（x86_64）；兼容版本可在应用内更新。
- **macOS SwiftUI 预览版（.dmg，已签名 + 公证）**：`Wisp-Science-SwiftUI-Preview_1.16.0_aarch64.dmg` 与 `_x86_64.dmg`，各附 `.sha256` 校验文件。v1.15.0 的预览版构建失败，这是它首次发布。安装前请先阅读“兼容性与适用范围”。
- **Windows（MSI / NSIS）**：SignPath 正式签名仍处于停用状态，安装包暂未签名。
- **Linux（deb / AppImage）**：x86_64 与 aarch64。

各平台构建完成后，安装包将陆续附加到下方 Assets。[官网下载页](https://wispscience.com/#download) 也提供按平台选择的安装包入口，使用已配置的下载镜像。

## 订阅账号

### 账号与模型分开配置

- **设置 → 模型**现在分为三个标签页：**API 模型**、**ACP Agents** 和**订阅账号**。订阅不再出现在 API 模型列表和协议选项中。
- ChatGPT 和 SuperGrok 各自管理登录。保存账号不会创建模型，之后可以为该账号添加任意多个模型，每个模型只需填写**模型 ID** 和**别名**。重新登录会更新该来源下所有模型的凭据。
- 编辑订阅模型时不会再被误存为普通 API 模型。
- **保存账号**按钮与“取消”并排，保存时显示进度。保存失败会保留授权，重试时无需重新登录。

### 多个 ChatGPT 账号

- ChatGPT 卡片提供**添加账号**和**导入本地登录**，并列出所有账号。每行显示邮箱和套餐，正在使用的账号带有“当前账号”标记。
- 每个账号显示 5 小时和每周两条额度条，并附重置倒计时。用量达到 80% 时变为琥珀色，达到 100% 时变为红色。**刷新额度**会重新读取用量。
- 同一时间只有一个账号处于使用状态。**使用此账号**会把所有 ChatGPT 模型切换到该账号，下一轮对话即生效。未使用的账号经确认后可以移除，当前账号不能移除。
- **导入本地登录**会读取 Codex CLI 的 `$CODEX_HOME/auth.json`（默认 `~/.codex/auth.json`）和 CLIProxyAPI 的 `~/.cli-proxy-api/codex-*.json`。每个账号只保留最新的一份，比 Wisp 已保存版本更旧的会被跳过。
- 本版本之前保存的账号，会在首次加载列表时显示为当前账号。

### 登录网络与错误提示

- **设置 → 网络 → 订阅账号登录**可以为 ChatGPT/xAI 登录、令牌刷新和额度查询单独设置代理，可选“系统”“直连”或“自定义”，默认为“系统”。模型请求走直连时，登录仍可以走代理。网络设置现在是独立的设置项，位于“常规”下方。
- 登录出错时会显示底层网络原因，并能识别 OpenAI 的“地区不支持”响应。错误信息不包含令牌或响应正文。
- ChatGPT：登录后发送消息不再报 HTTP 400。原因是订阅接口不接受 `max_output_tokens`，Wisp 已不再发送这个字段。以后如果请求中包含该接口不支持的参数，错误会直接说明是哪个参数。
- ChatGPT：只包含工具调用的轮次不再被判定为空回复。
- ChatGPT：登录时兼容只在 JWT 中给出过期时间的令牌，正确处理取消和迟到的回调；遇到 HTML 格式的 403 页面时显示可读的提示，不再显示整页 HTML。
- Windows：受凭据管理器 2560 字节的限制，较长的 ChatGPT/xAI 凭据以前无法保存。现在凭据会分片存入密钥环，受系统保护并带校验和。凭据不会退回 SQLite 或明文文件保存。

## 减少 Windows 卡顿

- v1.15 会在启动时于 UI 线程上迁移旧项目数据库，应用数据库较大时，窗口在显示前就会长时间无响应。现在启动时不再迁移旧项目，它们继续使用应用数据库；只有为某个项目开启网盘同步时，才会迁移该项目。
- 文件面板的文件系统命令不再在 UI 线程上执行，大文件夹、网盘占位文件和网络共享不会再让窗口卡住（[#1380](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1380)）。
- 显示桌宠时如果需要创建窗口，不会再死锁（[#1381](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1381)）。最大化按钮上的 Windows 贴靠布局浮层现在能正常加载（[#1379](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/issues/1379)）。
- 修复了一个界面故障：流式输出期间被移除的消息行或产物卡片会逐渐耗尽 WebAssembly 栈，长会话中可能导致窗口既不渲染也不响应输入。
- 离线的 MCP 连接器不再每轮都重试。连接失败会被记住 60 秒，Windows 上每条消息前约 2 秒的延迟因此消失。
- 升级到 Tauri 2.12。

## 其他改进与修复

- **设置 → 常规 → 项目去中心化存储**决定新项目的数据保存在各自的文件夹，还是共用应用数据库。全新安装和从 v1.14 直接升级时默认关闭，已运行过 v1.15.0 的安装保持开启。切换开关不会搬移已有项目。
- 被误设为图像生成的聊天模型，可以用**恢复为聊天模型**恢复，模型 ID 和凭据保持不变。
- 自动审查、后续问题建议和记忆提议现在也会在排队、IM 渠道、定时任务和委派发起的轮次中运行，不再依赖打开的窗口。被取消、拒绝或截断的 ACP 轮次不再触发审查。
- 已完成的 Run 监控合并到同一个“已处理”分组中，整轮耗时只显示一次，不再在每个分组重复显示。
- 打开的产物预览不会因为新的输出而重置缩放、标签页或未保存的代码修改。对话进行中，更早的消息仍可使用**复制**、**记忆**和**分支**。
- 恢复的对话历史中的本地图片重新可以正常显示。
- 对话中的目录路径会在文件面板中打开，不存在的路径显示为纯文本，不再是失效链接。
- 窗口较矮时，侧边栏靠下的入口会收进**更多**。所有文字随界面字号等比例缩放。收件箱角标只统计当前项目。
- 原生 SwiftUI（macOS）与 WinUI 3（Windows）预览版进一步向 WebView 版本看齐，覆盖设置、支持代码高亮和公式的消息渲染、产物面板、研究历程、日历和发表工作区。

## 兼容性与适用范围

- 全新安装和从 v1.14 升级时，**项目去中心化存储**默认关闭。已有项目留在应用数据库中，直到你为它开启网盘同步。项目迁移到自己的文件夹后，请不要降级到 v1.15 以下版本。
- 导入的 ChatGPT 登录与 Codex CLI 或 CLIProxyAPI 共用刷新令牌，Wisp 刷新令牌后，该工具可能需要重新登录。某个账号额度用尽时，Wisp 不会自动切换到其他账号。
- SwiftUI 和 WinUI 预览版的设置中仍只显示一个 ChatGPT 账号；WinUI 暂无订阅登录页面。
- 额度条读取的是 ChatGPT 未公开文档的用量接口，接口可能变化。
- 从源码构建现在需要 Rust 1.90 或更高版本。
- **SwiftUI 预览版**需要 macOS 13 或更高版本，以 **Wisp Science Preview.app** 的名称与正式版并存。它与 WebView 版本共用项目数据、设置和密钥环，并不隔离数据；只能手动下载更新，功能尚不完整。WebView 版本及其应用内更新不受影响。
